close.t: Claude Design now lives in Claude. The standalone Claude Design site (claude.ai/design) will close on December 14, 2026, and you can still access it until that

comments.t: Comments on your projects and design systems

links.t: Public links to projects in the standalone version will no longer work after it closes.

save.t: Save anything you need from your chats and comments before the standalone version closes.

download.t: Can I download all my projects?

share.t: Click "Share," then choose "Project HTML." For a slide deck, it's under "More formats and apps."

zip.t: You get a .zip file with every file in the project. It's free and doesn't count toward your usage limits.
